params.name: async
params.description: When true the API will return a results_id which can be fetched from the /data/v2/results endpoint when ready. **Note: it's recommended to use the sync flow (async=false) for all requests by adapting the [data workflow](https://docs.leantech.me/docs/data-workflow) for connected entities.**

params.name: page
params.description: The page you're requesting - returns page 0 of a response if not specified.

params.name: size
params.description: The number of objects you want to return as a page size.

params.name: entity_id
params.description: The entity_id you're querying for, which is created by LinkSDK `.connect()` function.

params.name: meta
params.description: Additional data you would like to store against the request. Example: {"foo": "val"}
